# Parse all notes: extract date and habit values
import re
parsed = []
for note in all_notes:
    title = note['title']
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    content = note['content']
    lines = content.split('\n')
    # Skip header line(s) that start with '#'
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            key, val = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[key.strip()] = val.strip().lower()
    parsed.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

# Check all notes have same habit keys
all_keys = [set(p['habits'].keys()) for p in parsed]
first_keys = all_keys[0]
consistent = all(k == first_keys for k in all_keys)
print("Consistent habit keys:", consistent)
print("Number of notes:", len(parsed))
print("First date:", parsed[0]['date'], "Last date:", parsed[-1]['date'])
print("Habit keys order:", list(parsed[0]['habits'].keys()))
